Exert chosen character.
zh: 直到永遠　⟳，橫置你一個角色 — 橫置指定角色。

name: Croquet Mallet
en:
HURTLING HEDGEHOG Banish this item — Chosen
character gains Rush this turn. (They can challenge the
turn they're played.)
zh: 飛奔的刺蝟　消滅這個物品 — 指定角色本回合獲得突襲。（他們在被打出的回合就能挑戰。）

name: Perplexing Signposts
en:
TO WONDERLAND Banish this item — Return chosen
character of yours to your hand.
zh: 往仙境　消滅這個物品 — 將你一個指定角色移回你的手牌。

name: The Sorcerer's Spellbook
en: KNOWLEDGE ⟳, 1 ⬡ — Gain 1 lore.
zh: 知識　⟳，1 ⬡ — 獲得 1 點傳說值。

name: Beast - Relentless
en:
SECOND WIND Whenever an opposing character
takes damage, you may ready this character.
zh: 再度振作　每當有對方角色受到傷害時，你可以準備這個角色。

name: Belle - Bookworm
en:
USE YOUR IMAGINATION While an opponent has
no cards in their hand, this character gets +2 ◊.
zh: 發揮想像力　當有對手手上沒有卡時，這個角色獲得 +2 ◊。

name: Belle - Hidden Archer
en:
Shift 3 (You may pay 3 ⬡ to play this on top of one of your
characters named Belle.)
THORNY ARROWS Whenever this character is challenged,
the challenging character's player discards all cards in their
hand.
zh:
變身 3（你可以支付 3 ⬡ 將這個角色打在你一個名為 Belle 的角色上。）
荊棘之箭　每當這個角色被挑戰時，進行挑戰的角色的玩家棄掉其手牌中所有卡。

name: Bucky - Squirrel Squeak Tutor
en:
SQUEAK Whenever you play a Floodborn character,
if you used Shift to play them, each opponent
chooses and discards a card.
zh: 吱吱　每當你打出一個 Floodborn 角色時，若你以變身打出他們，每位對手選擇並棄掉一張卡。

name: Cheshire Cat - From the Shadows
en:
Shift 5 (You may pay 5 ⬡ to play this on top of one of
your characters named Cheshire Cat.)
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can challenge this
character.)
WICKED SMILE ⟳ — Banish chosen damaged character.
zh:
變身 5（你可以支付 5 ⬡ 將這個角色打在你一個名為 Cheshire Cat 的角色上。）
迴避（只有具迴避的角色能挑戰這個角色。）
邪惡的笑容　⟳ — 消滅指定的受傷角色。

name: Daisy Duck - Secret Agent
en:
THWART Whenever this character quests, each
opponent chooses and discards a card.
zh: 阻撓　每當這個角色探險時，每位對手選擇並棄掉一張卡。

name: Donald Duck - Perfect Gentleman
en:
Shift 3 (You may pay 3 ⬡ to play this on top of
one of your characters named Donald Duck.)
ALLOW ME At the start of your turn, each player
may draw a card.
zh:
變身 3（你可以支付 3 ⬡ 將這個角色打在你一個名為 Donald Duck 的角色上。）
讓我來　在你的回合開始時，每位玩家可以抽一張牌。

name: Donald Duck - Sleepwalker
en:
STARTLED AWAKE Whenever you play an action,
this character gets +2 ¤ this turn.
zh: 驚醒　每當你打出一個行動時，這個角色本回合獲得 +2 ¤。

name: Dr. Facilier - Fortune Teller
en:
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can
challenge this character.)
YOU'RE IN MY WORLD Whenever this character
quests, chosen opposing character can't quest
during their next turn.
zh:
迴避（只有具迴避的角色能挑戰這個角色。）
你在我的世界裡　每當這個角色探險時，指定的對方角色在其下個回合不能探險。

name: Enchantress - Unexpected Judge
en:
TRUE FORM While being challenged, this
character gets +2 ¤.
zh: 真實形態　被挑戰時，這個角色獲得 +2 ¤。

name: Flynn Rider - His Own Biggest Fan
en:
Shift 2 (You may pay 2 ⬡ to play this on top of one of
your characters named Flynn Rider.)
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can challenge this
character.)
ONE LAST, BIG SCORE This character gets -1 ◊ for each
card in your opponents' hands.
zh:
變身 2（你可以支付 2 ⬡ 將這個角色打在你一個名為 Flynn Rider 的角色上。）
迴避（只有具迴避的角色能挑戰這個角色。）
最後一票大買賣　對手手牌每有一張卡，這個角色就獲得 -1 ◊。

name: Gaston - Scheming Suitor
en:
YES, I'M INTIMIDATING While one or more
opponents have no cards in their hands, this
character gets +3 ¤.
zh: 沒錯，我很嚇人　當有一個或多個對手手上沒有卡時，這個角色獲得 +3 ¤。

name: Lucifer - Cunning Cat
en:
MOUSE CATCHER When you play this character,
each opponent chooses and discards either 2
cards or 1 action card.
zh: 捕鼠者　當你打出這個角色時，每位對手選擇並棄掉 2 張卡或 1 張行動卡。

name: Pain - Underworld Imp
en:
COMING, YOUR MOST LUGUBRIOUSNESS While this
character has 5 ¤ or more, he gets +2 ◊.
zh: 來了，最陰鬱的大人　當這個角色有 5 ¤ 或以上時，他獲得 +2 ◊。

name: Panic - Underworld Imp
en:
I CAN HANDLE IT When you play this character,
chosen character gets +2 ¤ this turn. If the chosen
character is named Pain, he gets +4 ¤ instead.
zh: 我能搞定　當你打出這個角色時，指定角色本回合獲得 +2 ¤。若選擇的角色名為 Pain，他改為獲得 +4 ¤。

name: Pete - Bad Guy
en:
Ward (Opponents can't choose this character
except to challenge.)
TAKE THAT! Whenever you play an action, this
character gets +2 ¤ this turn.
WHO'S NEXT? While this character has 7 ¤ or
more, he gets +2 ◊.
zh:
守護（對手除了挑戰外不能選擇這個角色。）
接招！　每當你打出一個行動時，這個角色本回合獲得 +2 ¤。
下一個是誰？　當這個角色有 7 ¤ 或以上時，他獲得 +2 ◊。

name: Prince John - Greediest of All
en:
Ward (Opponents can't choose this character except to
challenge.)
I SENTENCE YOU Whenever your opponent discards
1 or more cards, you may draw a card for each card
discarded.
zh:
守護（對手除了挑戰外不能選擇這個角色。）
我判你有罪　每當你的對手棄掉 1 張或多張卡時，你可以每棄掉一張卡就抽一張牌。

name: Queen of Hearts - Quick-Tempered
en:
ROYAL RAGE When you play this character, deal 1
damage to chosen damaged opposing character.
zh: 皇家憤怒　當你打出這個角色時，對指定的受傷對方角色造成 1 點傷害。

name: Ratigan - Criminal Mastermind
en:
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can
challenge this character.)
zh: 迴避（只有具迴避的角色能挑戰這個角色。）

name: Ray - Easygoing Firefly
en:
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can
challenge this character.)
zh: 迴避（只有具迴避的角色能挑戰這個角色。）

name: The Queen - Disguised Peddler
en:
A PERFECT DISGUISE ⟳, Choose and discard a
character card — Gain lore equal to the discarded
character's ◊.
zh: 完美偽裝　⟳，選擇並棄掉一張角色卡 — 獲得等同被棄掉角色 ◊ 的傳說值。

name: Bibbidi Bobbidi Boo
en:
(A character with cost 3 or more can ⟳ to sing this song for
free.)
Return chosen character of yours to your hand to play a
character with the same cost or less for free.
zh:
（費用 3 或以上的角色可以橫置來免費詠唱這首歌。）
將你一個指定角色移回你的手牌，來免費打出一個費用相同或更低的角色。

name: Bounce
en:
Return chosen character of yours to your hand to
return another chosen character to their player's hand.
zh: 將你一個指定角色移回你的手牌，來將另一個指定角色移回其持有者的手牌。

name: Hypnotize
en:
Each opponent chooses and discards a card. Draw a
card.
zh: 每位對手選擇並棄掉一張卡。抽一張牌。

name: Improvise
en: Chosen character gets +1 ¤ this turn. Draw a card.
zh: 指定角色本回合獲得 +1 ¤。抽一張牌。

name: Pack Tactics
en:
Gain 1 lore for each damaged character opponents
have in play.
zh: 你每有一個對方的受傷角色在場，就獲得 1 點傳說值。

name: Ring the Bell
en: Banish chosen damaged character.
zh: 消滅指定的受傷角色。

name: Ratigan's Marvelous Trap
en:
SNAP! BOOM! TWANG! Banish this item — Each
opponent loses 2 lore.
zh: 啪！轟！鏘！　消滅這個物品 — 每位對手失去 2 點傳說值。

name: Donald Duck - Not Again!
en:
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can
challenge this character.)
PHOOEY! This character gets +1 ◊ for each 1
damage on him.
zh:
迴避（只有具迴避的角色能挑戰這個角色。）
呸！　他身上每有 1 點傷害，這個角色就獲得 +1 ◊。

name: Felicia - Always Hungry
en:
Reckless (This character can't quest and must
challenge each turn if able.)
zh: 魯莽（這個角色不能探險，且每回合若有能力必須挑戰。）

name: Fidget - Ratigan's Henchman
en:
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can
challenge this character.)
zh: 迴避（只有具迴避的角色能挑戰這個角色。）

name: Honest John - Not That Honest
en:
EASY STREET Whenever you play a Floodborn
character, each opponent loses 1 lore.
zh: 康莊大道　每當你打出一個 Floodborn 角色時，每位對手失去 1 點傳說值。

name: Lady Tremaine - Imperious Queen
en:
Shift 4 (You may pay 4 ⬡ to play this on top of one of your
characters named Lady Tremaine.)
POWER TO RULE AT LAST When you play this character, each
opponent chooses and banishes one of their characters.
zh:
變身 4（你可以支付 4 ⬡ 將這個角色打在你一個名為 Lady Tremaine 的角色上。）
終於能掌權　當你打出這個角色時，每位對手選擇並消滅其一個角色。

name: Lady Tremaine - Overbearing Matriarch
en:
NOT FOR YOU When you play this character, each
opponent with more lore than you loses 1 lore.
zh: 不給你　當你打出這個角色時，每個傳說值比你多的對手失去 1 點傳說值。

name: Minnie Mouse - Stylish Surfer
en:
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can
challenge this character.)
zh: 迴避（只有具迴避的角色能挑戰這個角色。）

name: Minnie Mouse - Wide-Eyed Diver
en:
Shift 2 (You may pay 2 ⬡ to play this on top of one of
your characters named Minnie Mouse.)
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can challenge this
character.)
UNDERSEA ADVENTURE Whenever you play a second
action in a turn, this character gets +2 ◊ this turn.
zh:
變身 2（你可以支付 2 ⬡ 將這個角色打在你一個名為 Minnie Mouse 的角色上。）
迴避（只有具迴避的角色能挑戰這個角色。）
海底冒險　每當你在一個回合打出第二個行動時，這個角色本回合獲得 +2 ◊。

name: Mother Gothel - Withered and Wicked
en:
WHAT HAVE YOU DONE?! This character enters
play with 3 damage.
zh: 你做了什麼？！　這個角色進場時帶有 3 點傷害。

name: Mulan - Soldier in Training
en:
Rush (This character can challenge the turn
they're played.)
zh: 突襲（這個角色在被打出的回合就能挑戰。）

name: Namaari - Nemesis
en:
THIS SHOULDN'T TAKE LONG ⟳, Banish this
character — Banish chosen character.
zh: 這用不了多久　⟳，消滅這個角色 — 消滅指定角色。

name: Queen of Hearts - Impulsive Ruler
en:
Rush (This character can challenge the turn
they're played.)
zh: 突襲（這個角色在被打出的回合就能挑戰。）

name: Queen of Hearts - Sensing Weakness
en:
Shift 2 (You may pay 2 ⬡ to play this on top of
one of your characters named Queen of Hearts.)
LET THE GAME BEGIN Whenever one of your
characters challenges another character, you may
draw a card.
zh:
變身 2（你可以支付 2 ⬡ 將這個角色打在你一個名為 Queen of Hearts 的角色上。）
遊戲開始　每當你一個角色挑戰另一個角色時，你可以抽一張牌。

name: Ratigan - Very Large Mouse
en:
THIS IS MY KINGDOM When you play this character,
exert chosen opposing character with 3 ¤ or less.
Choose one of your characters and ready them. They
can't quest for the rest of this turn.
zh: 這是我的王國　當你打出這個角色時，橫置一個 3 ¤ 或以下的指定對方角色。選擇你一個角色並準備他們。他們本回合剩餘時間內不能探險。

name: Raya - Headstrong
en:
NOTE TO SELF, DON'T DIE During your turn, whenever
this character banishes another character in a
challenge, you may ready this character. She can't
quest for the rest of this turn.
zh: 提醒自己，別死掉　在你的回合中，每當這個角色在挑戰中消滅另一個角色時，你可以準備這個角色。她本回合剩餘時間內不能探險。

name: Raya - Leader of Heart
en:
Shift 4 (You may pay 4 ⬡ to play this on top of
one of your characters named Raya.)
CHAMPION OF KUMANDRA Whenever this
character challenges a damaged character, she
takes no damage from the challenge.
zh:
變身 4（你可以支付 4 ⬡ 將這個角色打在你一個名為 Raya 的角色上。）
Kumandra 的鬥士　每當這個角色挑戰一個受傷角色時，她不受該次挑戰的傷害。

name: Scar - Vicious Cheater
en:
Rush (This character can challenge the turn
they're played.)
DADDY ISN'T HERE TO SAVE YOU During your
turn, whenever this character banishes another
character in a challenge, you may ready this
character. He can't quest for the rest of this turn.
zh:
突襲（這個角色在被打出的回合就能挑戰。）
爸爸不會來救你　在你的回合中，每當這個角色在挑戰中消滅另一個角色時，你可以準備這個角色。他本回合剩餘時間內不能探險。

name: Shere Khan - Menacing Predator
en:
DON'T INSULT MY INTELLIGENCE Whenever one
of your characters challenges another character,
gain 1 lore.
zh: 別侮辱我的智慧　每當你一個角色挑戰另一個角色時，獲得 1 點傳說值。

name: Tigger - One of a Kind
en:
ENERGETIC Whenever you play an action, this
character gets +2 ¤ this turn.
zh: 精力充沛　每當你打出一個行動時，這個角色本回合獲得 +2 ¤。

name: Tuk Tuk - Wrecking Ball
en:
Reckless (This character can't quest and must
challenge each turn if able.)
zh: 魯莽（這個角色不能探險，且每回合若有能力必須挑戰。）

name: Go the Distance
en:
(A character with cost 2 or more can ⟳ to sing this
song for free.)
Ready chosen damaged character of yours. They can't
quest for the rest of this turn. Draw a card.
zh:
（費用 2 或以上的角色可以橫置來免費詠唱這首歌。）
準備你一個指定的受傷角色。他們本回合剩餘時間內不能探險。抽一張牌。

name: Teeth and Ambitions
en:
(A character with cost 2 or more can ⟳ to sing this song for
free.)
Deal 2 damage to chosen character of yours to deal 2 damage
to another chosen character.
zh:
（費用 2 或以上的角色可以橫置來免費詠唱這首歌。）
對你一個指定角色造成 2 點傷害，來對另一個指定角色造成 2 點傷害。

name: The Most Diabolical Scheme
zh:
（費用 3 或以上的角色可以橫置來免費詠唱這首歌。）
消滅你一個指定的反派，來消滅指定角色。

name: What Did You Call Me?
en: Chosen damaged character gets +3 ¤ this turn.
zh: 指定的受傷角色本回合獲得 +3 ¤。

name: You Can Fly!
en:
(A character with cost 2 or more can ⟳ to sing this
song for free.)
Chosen character gains Evasive until the start of your
next turn. (Only characters with Evasive can challenge
them.)
zh:
（費用 2 或以上的角色可以橫置來免費詠唱這首歌。）
指定角色獲得迴避，直到你的下個回合開始。（只有具迴避的角色能挑戰他們。）

name: Dinner Bell
en:
YOU KNOW WHAT HAPPENS ⟳, 2 ⬡ — Draw cards
equal to the damage on chosen character of yours,
then banish them.
zh: 你知道會發生什麼　⟳，2 ⬡ — 抽取等同你一個指定角色身上傷害數量的牌，然後消滅他們。

name: Peter Pan's Dagger
en: Your characters with Evasive get +1 ¤.
zh: 你具迴避的角色獲得 +1 ¤。

name: Sword in the Stone
en:
⟳, 2 ⬡ — Chosen character gets +1 ¤ this turn for
each 1 damage on them.
zh: ⟳，2 ⬡ — 指定角色身上每有 1 點傷害，他們本回合就獲得 +1 ¤。

name: Alice - Growing Girl
en:
GOOD ADVICE Your other characters gain
Support. (Whenever they quest, you may add their
¤ to another chosen character's ¤ this turn.)
WHAT DID I DO? While this character has 10 ¤
or more, she gets +4 ◊.
zh:
好建議　你其他的角色獲得支援。（每當他們探險時，你可以在本回合把其 ¤ 加到另一個指定角色的 ¤ 上。）
我做了什麼？　當這個角色有 10 ¤ 或以上時，她獲得 +4 ◊。

name: Basil - Great Mouse Detective
en:
Shift 5 (You may pay 5 ⬡ to play this on top of one of
your characters named Basil.)
THERE'S ALWAYS A CHANCE If you used Shift to play this
character, you may draw 2 cards when he enters play.
zh:
變身 5（你可以支付 5 ⬡ 將這個角色打在你一個名為 Basil 的角色上。）
總有機會　若你以變身打出這個角色，當他進場時你可以抽兩張牌。

name: Basil - Of Baker Street
en:
Support (Whenever this character quests, you may
add their ¤ to another chosen character's ¤ this
turn.)
zh: 支援（每當這個角色探險時，你可以在本回合把其 ¤ 加到另一個指定角色的 ¤ 上。）

name: Cogsworth - Grandfather Clock
en:
Shift 3 (You may pay 3 ⬡ to play this on top of one of
your characters named Cogsworth.)
Ward (Opponents can't choose this character except to
challenge.)
UNWIND Your other characters gain Resist +1 (Damage
dealt to them is reduced by 1.)
zh:
變身 3（你可以支付 3 ⬡ 將這個角色打在你一個名為 Cogsworth 的角色上。）
守護（對手除了挑戰外不能選擇這個角色。）
放鬆　你其他的角色獲得抵抗 +1。（對他們造成的傷害減少 1。）

name: Cogsworth - Talking Clock
en:
WAIT A MINUTE Your characters with Reckless
gain “⟳ — Gain 1 lore.”
zh: 等一下　你具魯莽的角色獲得「⟳ — 獲得 1 點傳說值」。

name: Cruella De Vil - Fashionable Cruiser
en:
NOW GET GOING During your turn, this character
gains Evasive. (They can challenge characters
with Evasive.)
zh: 現在快走　在你的回合中，這個角色獲得迴避。（他們可以挑戰具迴避的角色。）

name: Cruella De Vil - Perfectly Wretched
en:
Shift 3 (You may pay 3 ⬡ to play this on top of one of
your characters named Cruella De Vil.)
OH, NO YOU DON'T Whenever this character quests,
chosen opposing character gets -2 ¤ this turn.
zh:
變身 3（你可以支付 3 ⬡ 將這個角色打在你一個名為 Cruella De Vil 的角色上。）
喔，休想　每當這個角色探險時，指定的對方角色本回合獲得 -2 ¤。

name: Duke Weaselton - Small-Time Crook
en:
Ward (Opponents can't choose this character
except to challenge.)
zh: 守護（對手除了挑戰外不能選擇這個角色。）

name: Gaston - Intellectual Powerhouse
en:
Shift 4 (You may pay 4 ⬡ to play this on top of
one of your characters named Gaston.)
DEVELOPED BRAIN When you play this character,
look at the top 3 cards of your deck. You may put
one into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of
your deck in any order.
zh:
變身 4（你可以支付 4 ⬡ 將這個角色打在你一個名為 Gaston 的角色上。）
發達的大腦　當你打出這個角色時，查看你牌庫頂 3 張卡。你可以將一張加入手牌。將其餘的以任意順序放到你牌庫底。

name: Grand Pabbie - Oldest and Wisest
en:
ANCIENT INSIGHT Whenever you remove 1 or
more damage from one of your characters, gain
2 lore.
zh: 古老洞察　每當你從自己一個角色身上移除 1 點或以上的傷害時，獲得 2 點傳說值。

name: Hiram Flaversham - Toymaker
en:
ARTIFICER When you play this character and
whenever he quests, you may banish one of your
items to draw 2 cards.
zh: 工匠　當你打出這個角色以及每當他探險時，你可以消滅你一個物品來抽兩張牌。

name: James - Role Model
en:
NEVER, EVER LOSE SIGHT When this character is
banished, you may put this card into your inkwell
facedown and exerted.
zh: 永不失去希望　當這個角色被消滅時，你可以將這張卡牌面朝下並橫置放入你的墨水池。

name: Jasmine - Heir of Agrabah
en:
I'M A FAST LEARNER When you play this
character, remove up to 1 damage from chosen
character of yours.
zh: 我學得很快　當你打出這個角色時，從你一個指定角色身上移除至多 1 點傷害。

name: Judy Hopps - Optimistic Officer
en:
DON'T CALL ME CUTE When you play this
character, you may banish chosen item. Its player
draws a card.
zh: 別叫我可愛　當你打出這個角色時，你可以消滅指定的物品。其持有者抽一張牌。

name: Mrs. Judson - Housekeeper
en:
TIDY UP Whenever you play a Floodborn
character, you may put the top card of your deck
into your inkwell facedown and exerted.
zh: 整理　每當你打出一個 Floodborn 角色時，你可以將你牌庫頂的卡牌面朝下並橫置放入你的墨水池。

name: Nick Wilde - Wily Fox
en:
IT'S CALLED A HUSTLE When you play this
character, you may return an item card named
Pawpsicle from your discard to your hand.
zh: 這叫做騙術　當你打出這個角色時，你可以將一張名為 Pawpsicle 的物品卡從棄牌堆移回你的手牌。

name: Noi - Orphaned Thief
en:
HIDE AND SEEK While you have an item in play,
this character gains Resist +1 and Ward. (Damage
dealt to this character is reduced by 1. Opponents
can't choose this character except to challenge.)
zh: 捉迷藏　當你有一個物品在場時，這個角色獲得抵抗 +1 和守護。（對這個角色造成的傷害減少 1。對手除了挑戰外不能選擇這個角色。）

name: Sisu - Divine Water Dragon
en:
I TRUST YOU Whenever this character quests,
look at the top 2 cards of your deck. You may put
one into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of
your deck in any order.
zh: 我信任你　每當這個角色探險時，查看你牌庫頂 2 張卡。你可以將一張加入手牌。將其餘的以任意順序放到你牌庫底。

name: The Nokk - Water Spirit
en:
Ward (Opponents can't choose this character
except to challenge.)
zh: 守護（對手除了挑戰外不能選擇這個角色。）

name: Winnie the Pooh - Having a Think
en:
HUNNY POT Whenever this character quests,
you may put a card from your hand into your
inkwell facedown.
zh: 蜂蜜罐　每當這個角色探險時，你可以將一張手牌牌面朝下放入你的墨水池。

name: Falling Down the Rabbit Hole
en:
Each player chooses one of their characters and puts
them into their inkwell facedown and exerted.
zh: 每位玩家選擇其一個角色並將他們牌面朝下並橫置放入墨水池。

name: Four Dozen Eggs
en:
(A character with cost 4 or more can ⟳ to sing this
song for free.)
Your characters gain Resist +2 until the start of your
next turn. (Damage dealt to them is reduced by 2.)
zh:
（費用 4 或以上的角色可以橫置來免費詠唱這首歌。）
你的角色獲得抵抗 +2，直到你的下個回合開始。（對他們造成的傷害減少 2。）

name: Launch
en:
Banish chosen item of yours to deal 5 damage to
chosen character.
zh: 消滅你一個指定物品，來對指定角色造成 5 點傷害。

name: Nothing to Hide
en: Each opponent reveals their hand. Draw a card.
zh: 每位對手展示其手牌。抽一張牌。

name: Fang Crossbow
en:
CAREFUL AIM ⟳, 2 ⬡ — Chosen character gets -2 ¤
this turn.
STAY BACK! ⟳, Banish this item — Banish chosen
Dragon character.
zh:
謹慎瞄準　⟳，2 ⬡ — 指定角色本回合獲得 -2 ¤。
退後！　⟳，消滅這個物品 — 消滅指定的龍角色。

name: Gumbo Pot
en:
THE BEST I'VE EVER TASTED ⟳ — Remove 1 damage
each from up to 2 chosen characters.
zh: 我吃過最棒的　⟳ — 從至多 2 個指定角色身上各移除 1 點傷害。

name: Maurice's Workshop
en:
LOOKING FOR THIS? Whenever you play another item,
you may pay 1 ⬡ to draw a card.
zh: 在找這個嗎？　每當你打出另一個物品時，你可以支付 1 ⬡ 抽一張牌。

name: Pawpsicle
en:
JUMBO POP When you play this item, you may draw a card.
THAT'S REDWOOD Banish this item — Remove up to 2 damage
from chosen character.
zh:
大冰棒　當你打出這個物品時，你可以抽一張牌。
那是紅杉木　消滅這個物品 — 從指定角色身上移除至多 2 點傷害。

name: Sardine Can
en:
FLIGHT CABIN Your exerted characters gain Ward.
(Opponents can't choose them except to challenge.)
zh: 飛行艙　你橫置的角色獲得守護。（對手除了挑戰外不能選擇他們。）

name: Beast - Forbidding Recluse
en:
YOU'RE NOT WELCOME HERE When you play this
character, you may deal 1 damage to chosen
character.
zh: 你在這不受歡迎　當你打出這個角色時，你可以對指定角色造成 1 點傷害。

name: Beast - Selfless Protector
en:
SHIELD ANOTHER Whenever one of your other
characters would be dealt damage, put that many
damage counters on this character instead.
zh: 為他人擋下　每當你另一個角色將受到傷害時，改為在這個角色上放置等量的傷害指示物。

name: Beast - Tragic Hero
en:
Shift 3 (You may pay 3 ⬡ to play this on top of one of your
characters named Beast.)
IT'S BETTER THIS WAY At the start of your turn, if this
character has no damage, draw a card. Otherwise, he gets
+4 ¤ this turn.
zh:
變身 3（你可以支付 3 ⬡ 將這個角色打在你一個名為 Beast 的角色上。）
這樣比較好　在你的回合開始時，若這個角色沒有傷害，抽一張牌；否則，他本回合獲得 +4 ¤。

name: Benja - Guardian of the Dragon Gem
en:
WE HAVE A CHOICE When you play this character,
you may banish chosen item.
zh: 我們有選擇　當你打出這個角色時，你可以消滅指定的物品。

name: Chief Bogo - Respected Officer
en:
INSUBORDINATION! Whenever you play a Floodborn
character, deal 1 damage to each opposing
character.
zh: 違抗命令！　每當你打出一個 Floodborn 角色時，對每個對方角色造成 1 點傷害。

name: Cinderella - Knight in Training
en:
HAVE COURAGE When you play this character,
you may draw a card, then choose and discard a
card.
zh: 拿出勇氣　當你打出這個角色時，你可以抽一張牌，然後選擇並棄掉一張卡。

name: Cinderella - Stouthearted
en:
Shift 5 (You may pay 5 ⬡ to play this on top of one of your
characters named Cinderella.)
Resist +2 (Damage dealt to this character is reduced by 2.)
THE SINGING SWORD Whenever you play a song, this
character may challenge ready characters this turn.
zh:
變身 5（你可以支付 5 ⬡ 將這個角色打在你一個名為 Cinderella 的角色上。）
抵抗 +2（這個角色受到的傷害減少 2。）
歌唱之劍　每當你打出一首歌時，這個角色本回合可以挑戰已準備的角色。

name: Hercules - Divine Hero
en:
Shift 4 (You may pay 4 ⬡ to play this on top of one of your
characters named Hercules.)
Resist +2 (Damage dealt to this character is reduced by 2.)
zh:
變身 4（你可以支付 4 ⬡ 將這個角色打在你一個名為 Hercules 的角色上。）
抵抗 +2（這個角色受到的傷害減少 2。）

name: Jafar - Dreadnought
en:
Shift 2 (You may pay 2 ⬡ to play this on top of
one of your characters named Jafar.)
NOW WHERE WERE WE? During your turn,
whenever this character banishes another
character in a challenge, you may draw a card.
zh:
變身 2（你可以支付 2 ⬡ 將這個角色打在你一個名為 Jafar 的角色上。）
剛剛講到哪？　在你的回合中，每當這個角色在挑戰中消滅另一個角色時，你可以抽一張牌。

name: Jafar - Royal Vizier
en:
I DON'T TRUST HIM, SIRE During your turn, this
character gains Evasive. (They can challenge
characters with Evasive.)
zh: 我不信任他，陛下　在你的回合中，這個角色獲得迴避。（他們可以挑戰具迴避的角色。）

name: Kronk - Junior Chipmunk
en:
Resist +1 (Damage dealt to this character is
reduced by 1.)
SCOUT LEADER During your turn, whenever
this character banishes another character in a
challenge, you may deal 2 damage to chosen
character.
zh:
抵抗 +1（這個角色受到的傷害減少 1。）
童軍隊長　在你的回合中，每當這個角色在挑戰中消滅另一個角色時，你可以對指定角色造成 2 點傷害。

name: Lawrence - Jealous Manservant
en:
PAYBACK While this character has no damage,
he gets +4 ¤.
zh: 報復　當這個角色沒有傷害時，他獲得 +4 ¤。

name: Li Shang - Archery Instructor
en:
ARCHERY LESSON Whenever this character
quests, your characters gain Evasive this turn.
(They can challenge characters with Evasive.)
zh: 射箭課　每當這個角色探險時，你的角色本回合獲得迴避。（他們可以挑戰具迴避的角色。）

name: Magic Broom - Industrial Model
en:
MAKE IT SHINE When you play this character,
chosen character gains Resist +1 until the start of
your next turn. (Damage dealt to them is reduced by 1.)
zh: 讓它閃耀　當你打出這個角色時，指定角色獲得抵抗 +1，直到你的下個回合開始。（對他們造成的傷害減少 1。）

name: Namaari - Morning Mist
en:
Bodyguard (This character may enter play exerted.
An opposing character who challenges one of
your characters must choose one with Bodyguard
if able.)
BLADES This character can challenge ready
characters.
zh:
護衛（這個角色可以橫置進場。挑戰你角色的對方角色，若有能力必須選擇具護衛的角色。）
雙刃　這個角色可以挑戰已準備的角色。

name: Queen of Hearts - Capricious Monarch
en:
OFF WITH THEIR HEADS! Whenever an opposing
character is banished, you may ready this
character.
zh: 砍掉他們的頭！　每當有對方角色被消滅時，你可以準備這個角色。

name: Robin Hood - Capable Fighter
en:
SKIRMISH ⟳ — Deal 1 damage to chosen
character.
zh: 小衝突　⟳ — 對指定角色造成 1 點傷害。

name: The Huntsman - Reluctant Enforcer
en:
CHANGE OF HEART Whenever this character
quests, you may draw a card, then choose and
discard a card.
zh: 回心轉意　每當這個角色探險時，你可以抽一張牌，然後選擇並棄掉一張卡。

name: The Prince - Never Gives Up
en:
Bodyguard (This character may enter play exerted.
An opposing character who challenges one of
your characters must choose one with Bodyguard
if able.)
Resist +1 (Damage dealt to this character is
reduced by 1.)
zh:
護衛（這個角色可以橫置進場。挑戰你角色的對方角色，若有能力必須選擇具護衛的角色。）
抵抗 +1（這個角色受到的傷害減少 1。）

name: Tiana - Celebrating Princess
en:
Resist +2 (Damage dealt to this character is
reduced by 2.)
WHAT YOU GIVE IS WHAT YOU GET While this
character is exerted and you have no cards in
your hand, opponents can't play actions.
zh:
抵抗 +2（這個角色受到的傷害減少 2。）
付出什麼就得到什麼　當這個角色橫置且你手上沒有卡時，對手不能打出行動。

name: Charge!
en:
Chosen character gains Challenger +2 and Resist +2
this turn. (They get +2 ¤ while challenging. Damage
dealt to them is reduced by 2.)
zh: 衝鋒！　指定角色本回合獲得挑戰者 +2 和抵抗 +2。（他們挑戰時獲得 +2 ¤。對他們造成的傷害減少 2。）

name: Let the Storm Rage On
en:
(A character with cost 3 or more can ⟳ to sing this
song for free.)
Deal 2 damage to chosen character. Draw a card.
zh:
（費用 3 或以上的角色可以橫置來免費詠唱這首歌。）
對指定角色造成 2 點傷害。抽一張牌。

name: Pick a Fight
en:
Chosen character can challenge ready characters this
turn.
zh: 指定角色本回合可以挑戰已準備的角色。

name: Strength of a Raging Fire
en:
(A character with cost 3 or more can ⟳ to sing this song for
free.)
Deal damage to chosen character equal to the number of
characters you have in play.
zh:
（費用 3 或以上的角色可以橫置來免費詠唱這首歌。）
對指定角色造成等同你在場角色數量的傷害。

name: Last Cannon
zh: 武裝自己　1 ⬡，消滅這個物品 — 指定角色本回合獲得挑戰者 +3。（他們挑戰時獲得 +3 ¤。）

name: Mouse Armor
en:
PROTECTION ⟳ — Chosen character gains Resist +1
until the start of your next turn. (Damage dealt to them
is reduced by 1.)
zh: 保護　⟳ — 指定角色獲得抵抗 +1，直到你的下個回合開始。（對他們造成的傷害減少 1。）

name: Weight Set
en:
TRAINING Whenever you play a character with 4 ¤ or
more, you may pay 1 ⬡ to draw a card.
zh: 訓練　每當你打出一個 4 ¤ 或以上的角色時，你可以支付 1 ⬡ 抽一張牌。

name: Cinderella - Ballroom Sensation
en: Singer 3 (This character counts as cost 3 to sing songs.)
zh: 歌手 3（這個角色視為費用 3 來詠唱歌曲。）

name: Snow White - Well Wisher
en:
Shift 4 (You may pay 4 ⬡ to play this on top of one
of your characters named Snow White.)
WISHES COME TRUE Whenever this character
quests, you may return a character card from your
discard to your hand.
zh:
變身 4（你可以支付 4 ⬡ 將這個角色打在你一個名為 Snow White 的角色上。）
願望成真　每當這個角色探險時，你可以將一張角色卡從你的棄牌堆移回手牌。

name: Arthur - Wizard's Apprentice
en:
STUDENT Whenever this character quests, you
may return another chosen character of yours to
your hand to gain 2 lore.
zh: 學生　每當這個角色探險時，你可以將你另一個指定角色移回你的手牌，來獲得 2 點傳說值。

name: Madam Mim - Purple Dragon
en:
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can
challenge this character.)
I WIN, I WIN! When you play this character, banish
her or return another 2 chosen characters of yours
to your hand.
zh:
迴避（只有具迴避的角色能挑戰這個角色。）
我贏了，我贏了！　當你打出這個角色時，消滅她，或將你另外 2 個指定角色移回你的手牌。

name: Pete - Bad Guy
en:
Ward (Opponents can't choose this character
except to challenge.)
TAKE THAT! Whenever you play an action, this
character gets +2 ¤ this turn.
WHO'S NEXT? While this character has 7 ¤ or
more, he gets +2 ◊.
zh:
守護（對手除了挑戰外不能選擇這個角色。）
接招！　每當你打出一個行動時，這個角色本回合獲得 +2 ¤。
下一個是誰？　當這個角色有 7 ¤ 或以上時，他獲得 +2 ◊。

name: Beast - Relentless
en:
SECOND WIND Whenever an opposing character
takes damage, you may ready this character.
zh: 再度振作　每當有對方角色受到傷害時，你可以準備這個角色。

name: Lady Tremaine - Imperious Queen
en:
Shift 4 (You may pay 4 ⬡ to play this on top of one
of your characters named Lady Tremaine.)
POWER TO RULE AT LAST When you play this
character, each opponent chooses and banishes
one of their characters.
zh:
變身 4（你可以支付 4 ⬡ 將這個角色打在你一個名為 Lady Tremaine 的角色上。）
終於能掌權　當你打出這個角色時，每位對手選擇並消滅其一個角色。

name: Shere Khan - Menacing Predator
en:
DON'T INSULT MY INTELLIGENCE Whenever one of
your characters challenges another character, gain
1 lore.
zh: 別侮辱我的智慧　每當你一個角色挑戰另一個角色時，獲得 1 點傳說值。

name: Alice - Growing Girl
en:
GOOD ADVICE Your other characters gain Support.
(Whenever they quest, you may add their ¤ to
another chosen character's ¤ this turn.)
WHAT DID I DO? While this character has 10 ¤ or
more, she gets +4 ◊.
zh:
好建議　你其他的角色獲得支援。（每當他們探險時，你可以在本回合把其 ¤ 加到另一個指定角色的 ¤ 上。）
我做了什麼？　當這個角色有 10 ¤ 或以上時，她獲得 +4 ◊。

name: Sisu - Divine Water Dragon
en:
I TRUST YOU Whenever this character quests, look
at the top 2 cards of your deck. You may put one
into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your
deck in any order.
zh: 我信任你　每當這個角色探險時，查看你牌庫頂 2 張卡。你可以將一張加入手牌。將其餘的以任意順序放到你牌庫底。

name: Hercules - Divine Hero
en:
Shift 4 (You may pay 4 ⬡ to play this on top of one
of your characters named Hercules.)
Resist +2 (Damage dealt to this character is
reduced by 2.)
zh:
變身 4（你可以支付 4 ⬡ 將這個角色打在你一個名為 Hercules 的角色上。）
抵抗 +2（這個角色受到的傷害減少 2。）

name: Namaari - Morning Mist
en:
Bodyguard (This character may enter play exerted.
An opposing character who challenges one of your
characters must choose one with Bodyguard if
able.)
BLADES This character can challenge ready
characters.
zh:
護衛（這個角色可以橫置進場。挑戰你角色的對方角色，若有能力必須選擇具護衛的角色。）
雙刃　這個角色可以挑戰已準備的角色。
